text:
Samir Khan: Need a concise one-pager for sales + field that compares Hosted / Dedicated / Private for enterprise buyers. Focus: security controls, SLA guarantees, and migration recommendations. Can someone take lead?
Ana Gomez: I can start. What's the target audience? AE vs SE?
Samir Khan: Primary: AEs and Solutions Engineers who are meeting CISOs and infra leads. Secondary: marketing assets for website/one-off email to prospects.
Tara O'Neill: Got it. Suggested sections: TL;DR (3 bullets), quick comparison table (latency/cost/SLA/data residency), recommended buyer persona + migration path, callouts for compliance (FedRAMP/GovCloud/VPC), and a short checklist for the AE before demo.
Devon Lee: From product: use these SLA numbers in the brief: Hosted: 99.5% uptime SLA (standard), Dedicated: 99.9% with reserved capacity, Private: depends on customer infra (we provide install + ops support). Also mention typical P95 latency ranges: Hosted 80-200ms, Dedicated 40-80ms, Private 60-180ms (varies with instance type).
Ana Gomez: For the cost note, can we include a headline range instead of exact price? e.g., "Unit cost: Hosted (lower start-up cost), Dedicated (40-60% lower unit cost at scale), Private (lowest unit cost when amortized but higher ops)."
Samir Khan: Yes, keep numbers expressive not prescriptive. Also include a short callout: "When to choose Dedicated: predictable traffic, latency SLOs, and enterprise contracts. When to choose Private: maximum data control and lowest long-term unit cost. Hosted: fastest to go-live and easiest evaluation."
Tara O'Neill: I'll draft the visual 1-pager layout. For gated collateral, we should add a short form that asks deployment interest + compliance needs. Draft SFDC form fields below: 
```
- email
- full_name
- company
- title
- company_size
- region
- deployment_interest (hosted/dedicated/private)
- compliance_requirements (checkboxes: SOC2, ISO, FedRAMP, HIPAA, Other)
- desired_sla (free text)
```
Devon Lee: Add a hidden_field: "source_asset=deploy_decider_1pager" so AEs can see inbound context.
OpsBot: Reminder queued: Asset draft due in /marketing-assets/onepagers by 1725060000.
Ana Gomez: For messaging tone: use "practical and trustable" — call out tradeoffs plainly, avoid hyperbole. Include a tiny section on "what we run in production" with model families supported and kernel/quantization options.
Samir Khan: Good. Also include a 1-paragraph methodology appendix that references benchmark script and distribution (chatty prompts, 50-300 token sequences). Devon: can you attach the example eval command?
Devon Lee: Example reproducibility snippet for appendix: 
```
./run_eval --model redwood-dedicated-v1 --workload chat --seq-min 50 --seq-max 300 --tokens 200000 --capture p50 p95 cost_per_million
```
Tara O'Neill: I'll make two variants: a printable PDF one-pager for AEs and a gated HTML landing brief for lead gen. Want both copy sets to be consistent.
Ana Gomez: I'll produce the copy and a short LinkedIn blurb that AEs can share with prospects. Samir, want to review first draft before we lock?
Samir Khan: Yes please. Schedule a 20-min review tomorrow 10:30. OpsBot: create calendar invite?
OpsBot: Invite created for 1725056600 (tomorrow 10:30).
Tara O'Neill: Noted. I'll upload the first layout + plaintext copy by 1725059000.
Samir Khan: Thanks team — if we keep the brief transparent about SLAs and operational tradeoffs, it tends to speed up the qualification conversation. :white_check_mark:
